post.description: Authenticated patient reserves a slot with Redis lock + pending payment order.
Patient submits payment verification to atomically confirm booking.
Initiate gateway order for an appointment fee.

Atomic capture: update PaymentTransaction to CAPTURED, confirm appointment,
and release Redis slot lock.
Authenticated user cancels an appointment with a mandatory reason.
Doctor or clinic confirms the appointment (REQUESTED -> CONFIRMED).
